syncBody: The template's latest version will overwrite: {{fields}}. Your name and description stay.

segmentHint.mine: Your own copies; edit freely and sync when a template is updated.
segmentHint.saas: Copy a SaaS template to create your own component; the template itself is read-only.

editor.fromTemplate: Copied from SaaS template v{{version}}; changes only affect this tenant.
editor.platformNote: Tenants can copy this template as their own component.
editor.typeHint: Changing the type resets the schema, sample data and trigger tag to that type's defaults.
editor.tagHint: The model wraps its JSON in this tag and the gateway renders the component. Lower-cased; characters other than a-z, 0-9 and _ become _.
editor.versionHint: Raise the version when the schema, trigger tag or compatibility matrix changes.
editor.schemaHint: The structure the agent passes in. A trailing ? marks an optional field; types such as string, number, string[], { label: string; url: string }[]; standard JSON Schema also works.
editor.badJson: Invalid JSON, please check the syntax.
editor.compatHint: A channel marked Off cannot select this component.
editor.tenantFoot: Saved to this tenant's library only.
editor.platformFoot: Tenants who copied it will see a sync prompt after a version change.
